answer: To resist Sybil attacks, networks mandate bonded staking where game-theoretic multi-agent auditing enforces stake slashing against coordinated fraud. Topological cut verifications trace transaction flow across trust bottlenecks: an attacker forging a synthetic river of accounts to dilute audits faces superlinear attacker cost scaling with graph partition capacity. Cross-validating each audit thread with a cryptographic cipher guarantees fast, deterministic penalties.
